description: Always-on plugin autodiscovery, kept out of pc-core so it survives the very scenario it exists for (a session where pc-core is not loaded). Ascends at SessionStart / descends at CwdChanged / restores at SessionEnd to enable every project-scoped plugin matching the session's location; nudges a commit when the only uncommitted change is that activation; and turns the next tool call into a permission stop while a user-only slash command (/reload-plugins, /goal) is still pending — see sync_plugin_scope.py, settings_commit_nudge.py, pending_gate.py, clear_pending_queue.py. Also regenerates the workspace and group AGENTS.md files on disk at SessionStart, rewriting only what changed — see agents-md/agents_md_hook.py.
